title: Special Topics in Film Theories; Cinema and Religion
description:
Cross-listed with RELS319G. Credit only granted for CINE369R or RELS319G.

How does religion make itself felt within cinema, the most modern of expressive media? And how does a critical perspective informed by religion affect an understanding of cinema? In this course, we will ask questions about how cinema renders religious stories and spirituality in general. What is the relation between cinematic aesthetics and religious experience?
